---
title: "On-time performance"
---

::: {.method-note}
These figures are inferred from bus positions, not reported by Island
Transit. Automatic checks run on every route every day; in-person checks
are ongoing and so far cover route 60, where timed stops agreed with the
inferred times within seconds. See [Methods](methods.qmd), sections 3 to 5,
and the field check below.
:::

A bus is **on time** at a timepoint when it leaves between 1 minute early
and 5 minutes late (at the last stop of a trip, its arrival counts, and an
early arrival is on time). Timepoints are the stops printed in Island
Transit's timetables. Events with no inferred time are **not observed**:
they are reported separately and never counted as late.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
import {csv, json, pct, num, routeLabel, SERIES} from "./lib.js"
daily = csv(d3, "data/ontime/daily.csv")
days = daily.map(d => ({...d, date: new Date(d.service_date)}))
latestDate = days.length ? days.at(-1).date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) : null
latest = latestDate ? json(`data/ontime/days/${latestDate}.json`) : null
noData = () => html`<p>No processed days yet.</p>`
```

## Over time

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pair = [
  {key: "on_time_share_of_observed", title: "On time, share of observed timepoint events"},
  {key: "observed_share", title: "Observed, share of scheduled timepoint events"},
]
html`${days.length === 0 ? noData() : html`<div class="grid">${pair.map(s => html`<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6">
  <h4 style="font-size:1rem">${s.title}</h4>
  ${Plot.plot({
    style: {background: "transparent"},
    height: 200, marginLeft: 50,
    x: {type: "utc", label: null},
    y: {grid: true, label: null, domain: [0, 1], tickFormat: d => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
      Plot.lineY(days, {x: "date", y: s.key, stroke: SERIES, strokeWidth: 2}),
      Plot.dot(days, {x: "date", y: s.key, fill: SERIES, r: 4}),
      Plot.tip(days, Plot.pointerX({x: "date", y: s.key,
        title: d => `${d.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}\n${pct(d[s.key], 1)}`})),
    ],
  })}</div>`)}</div>`}`
```

## Latest day by route

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
routes = latest == null ? [] : Object.entries(latest.by_route).map(([id, r]) => ({
  route: routeLabel(latest.routes, id), ...r}))
html`${latest == null ? noData() : html`<p>Service day <strong>${latestDate}</strong>:
  ${latest.scheduled} scheduled timepoint events, ${pct(latest.observed_share)} observed,
  ${pct(latest.on_time_share_of_observed)} of those on time; median deviation
  ${num(latest.deviation_s_median / 60, 1)} minutes.</p>`}`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
MIN_OBSERVED = 10
charted = routes.filter(d => d.observed >= MIN_OBSERVED)
html`${routes.length === 0 ? "" : html`${Plot.plot({
    style: {background: "transparent"},
  marginLeft: 220, height: 28 * charted.length + 40,
  x: {domain: [0, 1], grid: true, label: "On time, share of observed timepoint events", tickFormat: d => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`},
  y: {label: null},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(charted, {y: "route", x: "on_time_share_of_observed", fill: SERIES, rx: 2, sort: {y: "x", reverse: true}}),
    Plot.ruleX([0]),
    Plot.tip(charted, Plot.pointerY({y: "route", x: "on_time_share_of_observed",
      title: d => `${d.route}\non time ${d.on_time}, early ${d.early}, late ${d.late}\nobserved ${d.observed} of ${d.scheduled} (${pct(d.observed_share)})`})),
  ],
})}<p class="small">Routes with fewer than ${MIN_OBSERVED} observed timepoint events that day are left out of the chart; all routes are in the table below.</p>`}`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`${routes.length === 0 ? "" : Inputs.table(routes, {
  columns: ["route", "scheduled", "observed", "observed_share", "on_time", "early", "late", "on_time_share_of_observed", "deviation_s_median"],
  header: {route: "Route", scheduled: "Scheduled", observed: "Observed", observed_share: "Observed share",
           on_time: "On time", early: "Early", late: "Late", on_time_share_of_observed: "On-time share",
           deviation_s_median: "Median deviation (s)"},
  format: {observed_share: d => pct(d), on_time_share_of_observed: d => pct(d)}, rows: 30})}`
```

## Automatic checks of the method

Two checks run every day without field data ([Methods](methods.qmd),
section 5). Each bus report names the stop the bus is heading for; when the
bus passes a stop, that changes to the next one. An inferred departure
agrees with the feed when it falls between the last report naming that stop
and the first naming a later one, give or take 30 seconds. Travel between
consecutive inferred times should never run backwards or faster than
126 km/h.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
val = latest?.validation ?? null
checks = val == null ? [] : [
  ["Inferred departures compared with the feed", val.feed_agreement.compared],
  ["Agree with the feed's change of stop (within 30 s)", pct(val.feed_agreement.within_tolerance_share, 1)],
  ["Median time from inferred departure to the first report naming the next stop",
    `${num(val.feed_agreement.feed_change_after_departure_s.median, 1)} s`],
  ["Times the feed's stop sequence went backwards within a trip", val.feed_agreement.feed_sequence_going_backwards],
  ["Segments between inferred times", val.travel_times.segments],
  ["Segments running backwards in time", val.travel_times.negative],
  ["Segments faster than 126 km/h", val.travel_times.over_max_speed],
].map(([check, value]) => ({check, value}))
html`${checks.length === 0 ? noData() : Inputs.table(checks, {header: {check: "Check", value: "Result"}, rows: 10})}`
```

## Field check

A spot check of whether the inferred times match what happens on the
street: arrivals and departures timed in person, with a target mean absolute
difference of 30 seconds or less. It was done on route 60, from on board; it
does not cover other routes, departures after a bus has waited at a
timepoint, or departures from terminals. The two automatic checks above
cover every route every day. The observer times the same moments the method infers: the bus coming within
40 m of the stop, and the bus more than 40 m past it, or the moment the bus
is level with the stop (compared with the midpoint of the two).

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
fc = json("data/ontime/field-check.json")
fcRows = fc == null || fc.overall.n === 0 ? [] : [["All", fc.overall], ["Arrivals (40 m before)", fc.arrival], ["Departures (40 m past)", fc.departure], ["Level with the stop", fc.pass ?? {n: 0}]]
  .filter(([, s]) => s.n > 0)
  .map(([moment, s]) => ({moment, n: s.n, bias: s.bias_s, mae: s.mae_s, w30: s.within_30s_share, w60: s.within_60s_share}))
html`${fcRows.length === 0
  ? html`<p>No timed observations yet${fc && fc.rows_waiting_for_their_day ? ` (${fc.rows_waiting_for_their_day} waiting for their day to be processed)` : ""}.</p>`
  : html`<p>${fc.overall.n} timed moments on ${fc.days.length} day${fc.days.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}.
      Differences are inferred minus timed, in seconds; a positive bias means the method's times are later.
      Target met: <strong>${fc.meets_target ? "yes" : "not yet"}</strong>.</p>
    ${Inputs.table(fcRows, {
      header: {moment: "", n: "Timed", bias: "Bias (s)", mae: "Mean absolute difference (s)", w30: "Within 30 s", w60: "Within 60 s"},
      format: {bias: d => num(d, 1), mae: d => num(d, 1), w30: d => pct(d), w60: d => pct(d)}, rows: 5})}`}`
```

The timed observations: [`reference/field-observations.csv`](https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/blob/main/reference/field-observations.csv);
every pair compared: [`ontime/field-check.json`](https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/blob/data/ontime/field-check.json).

Daily figures as a file:
[`ontime/daily.csv`](https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/blob/data/ontime/daily.csv).
Every inferred arrival and departure is in the `stop-events` files in the
[Releases](https://github.com/dfladagermccullugh-bot/Open-Island-Transit-Data/releases).
